@@ @@

+ What is this?
[[div class="blockquote"]]
This theme was developed by [[*user Kilerpoyo]] to be used in "Día de Muertos" themed pages.

This theme is a modified extension of the Old Money theme by [[*user djkaktus]] & [[*user woedenaz]].
[[/div]]
----

@@ @@

+ Usage

[[div_ style="filter: invert(1) brightness(110%);display:flex;"]]
[[image https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/theme%3Ablack-highlighter-theme/black-highlighter-logo.svg]]
[[/div]]

++ Note: This is a Black Highlighter based theme. You will need to import the Black Highlighter theme as well in order to use this theme. [[[theme:black-highlighter-theme|To learn more go here]]].

@@ @@

On any wiki:

[[div class="code"]]
@@[[include :scp-wiki:theme:black-highlighter-theme]]@@
@@[[include :scp-wiki:theme:old-money-theme]]@@
@@[[include :scp-wiki:theme:dia-de-muertos]]@@
[[/div]]

@@ @@

+ Examples

A horizontal rule can be created with 5 hyphens "@@-----@@" and extends across the whole page if it's not placed inside anything (eg a blockquote). The lines separating sections of this document are horizontal rules.

-----

Titles can be created by putting between one and six plus "+" at the start of the line

[[collapsible show="+ Titles" hide="- Titles"]]
+ First Title

++ Second Title

+++ Third Title

++++ Fourth Title

+++++ Fifth Title

++++++ Sixth Title
[[/collapsible]]

They say that Death fell in love with México. It was certainly because of the Mezcal and Tequila.

Japan has the shinigamis, for the Greeks it was Thanatos and Hades... but here in Mexico is La Catrina, and of all the Lords of Death she is the Fanciest.

How quaint.

en esta situación tan difícil por la que atravieso,
conoces el dolor por el que estoy padeciendo,
tengo un problema muy difícil,
sé que usted lo va a solucionar.

[[=]]
The body font is Verdana.
[[span style="font-family: var(--header-font);"]]The headers and Title font is Colus.[[/span]]
[[span style="font-family: var(--mono-font);"]]The monospace font used is Monaco.[[/span]]
[[span style="font-family: var(--decorative-font); font-size:300%"]]The Header and Decorative font used is Papel Picado.[[/span]]

[[span style="font-family: var(--decorative-font); font-size:700%"]]$ / #
@ & : ?[[/span]]

[[span style="font-family: var(--decorative-font2); font-size:300%"]]The alternative Decorative font is Dobuled Crossed.[[/span]]

**Note:** Please keep in mind the text legibility when using the Decorative Fonts.

[[/=]]

-----

[[collapsible show="+ Show theme code" hide="- Hide theme code"]]
[[code type="css"]]

/*
   Día de Muertos Theme
   [2022 Wikidot Theme]
   by Kilerpoyo
          an extension of Old Money Theme by djkaktus & Woedenaz.
*/

@import url('https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/theme%3Adia-de-muertos/papelpicadostyle.css');
@import url('https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/theme%3Adia-de-muertos/doubled-crossed.css');
@import url('https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/theme%3Adia-de-muertos/colus.css');

:root {

    --theme-id: "dia-de-muertos";
    --theme-name: "Dia de Muertos Theme";

    --logo-image: url("https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/local--files/theme:dia-de-muertos/muertoswhite.png");
    --header-title: ":SCP&";
    --header-subtitle: "Nadie sale vivo de esta vida.";

    /* Typefaces */
    --body-font: Verdana, serif;
    --header-font: 'Colus', Verdana, serif;
    --title-font: 'Colus', Verdana, serif;
    --UI-font: --UI-font: Roboto, sans-serif;
    --mono-font: monaco, monospace;
    --decorative-font: 'papel_picadoregular', 'Colus', Verdana;
    --decorative-font2: 'double_crossedregular', 'Colus', Verdana;

    /* Día de Muertos theme palette */
    --mexican-pink: 228, 0, 124;
    --pink-flamingo: 184, 0, 101;
    --yellow-submarine: 255, 247, 0;
    --deep-purple: 113, 23, 145;
    --cempasuchil-fields: 255, 128, 0;
    --pale-lady: 243, 241, 238;
    --charro-negro: 12, 12, 12;


    /* THEME ASSIGNMENTS */
    --white-monochrome: var(--pale-lady);
    --gray-monochrome: var(--mexican-pink);
    --dark-gray-monochrome: var(--pink-flamingo);
    --black-monochrome: var(--charro-negro);
    --pale-accent: var(--cempasuchil-fields);
    --bright-accent: var(--cempasuchil-fields);
    --medium-accent: var(--pink-flamingo);
    --dark-accent: var(--deep-purple);
    --alt-accent: var(--yellow-submarine);

    /* MISCH TWEAKS */
    --swatch-tertiary-color: var(--pink-flamingo);
    --link-color: var(--yellow-submarine);
    --visited-link-color: var(--cempasuchil-fields);

}

/* Webkit Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(var(--mexican-pink), 1);
}

/* YUI NAV BAR */
.yui-navset .yui-nav a:hover,
.yui-navset .yui-nav a:active,
.yui-navset .yui-nav a:focus {
    color: rgb(var(--pale-lady));
}

/* TOP BAR */
#top-bar {
    --topmenu-hover-border-color: var(--bright-accent);
}


/* HEADER H1 */
#header h1 a::before {
    font-size: 2em;
    --wght: 100;
    background-blend-mode: normal;
    font-family: var(--decorative-font);
}

#header h1 a::before {
    background-image: linear-gradient(left, rgb(var(--mexican-pink)) 0em, rgb(var(--mexican-pink)) 1.1em, rgb(var(--cempasuchil-fields)) 1.1em, rgb(var(--cempasuchil-fields)) 2.75em, rgb(var(--pale-lady)) 2.75em, rgb(var(--pale-lady)) 20em);
    background-image: -webkit-linear-gradient(left, rgb(var(--mexican-pink)) 0em, rgb(var(--mexican-pink)) 1.1em, rgb(var(--cempasuchil-fields)) 1.1em, rgb(var(--cempasuchil-fields)) 2.75em, rgb(var(--pale-lady)) 2.75em, rgb(var(--pale-lady)) 20em);
    background-size: 20em;
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    text-fill-color: transparent;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

/* HEADER H2 */
#header h2 span {
    margin-top: calc(((var(--header-height-on-desktop) / 2) + (var(--header-h1-font-size) / 2) - var(--header-h2-font-size) + 2em));
    font-size: 1em;
}

/* PAGE TITLES */
#page-title,
.meta-title,
#page-content h1,
#page-content h2,
#page-content h3,
#page-content h4,
#page-content h5,
#page-content h6 {
    -webkit-background-clip: none;
    background-clip: none;
    background-color: rgb(var(--yellow-submarine));
    background-image: none;
    background-blend-mode: normal;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(var(--yellow-submarine));
}

/* SIDE BAR HEADING */
#side-bar .heading p,
#interwiki .heading p {
    background-image: none;
    -webkit-background-clip: none;
    background-clip: none;
    color: rgb(var(--swatch-menutxt-dark-color));
    color: rgb(var(--bright-accent));
    -webkit-text-fill-color: rgb(var(--bright-accent));
    overflow-wrap: normal;
}

/* TABLE WIKI */
table.wiki-content-table th {
    background-color: rgb(var(--swatch-primary-darker));
    background-image: none;
}


/* MOBILE SUPPORT */
@media only screen and (max-width: 56.25rem) {

    /* HEADER H1 */
    #header h1 a {
    	margin-top: calc(((var(--header-height-on-mobile) / 2)) - 0.75em);
    	margin-left: calc(var(--header-height-on-mobile) - 3.5rem);
    	font-size: clamp(1.1em, 7vw, 3em);
    	line-height: 0.5;
    }

    #header h1 a::before {
    	font-size: 3.5rem;
    }

    /* HEADER H2 */
    #header h2 span {
    	margin-top: calc(((var(--header-height-on-mobile) / 2) + 1.5em));
    	margin-left: calc(var(--header-height-on-mobile) - 3.5rem);
    	font-size: 0.75em;
    	line-height: 1;
    	text-align: left;
    }
}
[[/code]]
[[/collapsible]]
